CIG Shanghai.why: optical-module maker whose high-speed (800G/1.6T) transceiver sales for overseas cloud customers drove H1 2026 revenue up 32.92% and net profit up 171.08%
CIG Shanghai.evidence: CIG Shanghai IR activity record: 2026-003 (09-07-2026): H1 2026 growth mainly from high-speed optical modules; 800G certified by several major customers and shipping in volume; 1.6T mass production expected in H2 2026

players.product: 800G and 1.6T OSFP optical transceivers (silicon-photonics and EML designs), ELSFP external light sources, and NPO/CPO optical engines in development

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 revenue RMB 27.05 hundred-million, up 32.92% year on year; net profit attributable RMB 3.28 hundred-million, up 171.08%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 3.19 hundred-million, up 168.42%; basic EPS RMB 0.93, up 106.67%. Growth came mainly from high-speed optical modules, where strong demand drove a large rise in orders and shipments, and the product-mix shift lifted gross margin significantly.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB 27.05 hundred-million (+32.92%); net profit RMB 3.28 hundred-million (+171.08%); EPS RMB 0.93 (+106.67%)

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Gerald G Wong: the optical-connectivity market keeps growing; the industry's own expectation for 2027 is about 1.8-2 hundred-million modules above 100G, mainly 800G and 1.6T, with 1.6T about 8,000 ten-thousand units, so industry capacity expansion will continue. Upstream chips (laser chips, DSPs) are short of capacity, and expanding them is constrained by equipment supply, investment and talent.
quarterly_data.figure: 2027 industry expectation about 1.8-2 hundred-million >100G modules; 1.6T about 8,000 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Gerald G Wong: silicon-photonics modules scale up more easily than traditional EML designs; at 100G/lane (800G) the two are at parity, at 200G/lane (1.6T) silicon photonics has the edge, and at 400G/lane EML currently leads because of silicon-modulator bandwidth limits. Thin-film lithium niobate could improve modulator performance and the company is investing via capital and technical partnerships; management said a pure thin-film lithium niobate design will not work for 3.2T/400G and an integrated design is required. External-light-source NPO is a clear future direction. The company started silicon-photonics R&D six years ago and commercialised it three years ago.

Management (IR record): 800G has completed certification at several major customers and is shipping in volume; 1.6T mass production is expected in H2 2026; 3.2T is progressing per plan. In NPO/CPO, the external-light-source design comes first, with prototypes imminent and customised projects with leading customers; an integrated-laser NPO/CPO design is expected in H2 2027, developed with domestic and overseas partners. A 3.2T 10-15 km long-reach module based on thin-film lithium niobate is in development; the platform is run by a partner under joint development, with the first 10-15 km version expected by year-end.

Management (IR record): through strategic investment and co-development the company works with more than 20 upstream companies across silicon-photonics chips, lithium niobate, InP substrates, lasers, passive components and production equipment, lining up 2-3 suppliers for each core component to secure supply and capacity.

Management (IR record): the target of at least 600 ten-thousand units of annualized module capacity by end-2026 was reached early, with expansion continuing and a chance of reaching the ten-million level within the year; capacity will keep climbing next year. Production is mainly in China and Malaysia (domestic base for R&D and equipment tuning, overseas for volume); the Mexico base is expected to start production in early 2027; the leased Jiashan plant 2 is similar in scale to Malaysia. Current orders are mainly overseas, and overseas plants are expected to exceed half of capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: annualized capacity of at least 600 ten-thousand units reached early; Mexico base early 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): NPO development is ahead of the original plan - the first 3 prototypes are due at the end of this month with testing completed by year-end; small-batch production is expected in Q1 next year and volume in Q2-Q3 next year (based on customer feedback, not a commitment). NPO is in joint development with leading cloud providers and designated switch partners; initial demand and material pressure are small. ELSFP external light sources are still shipping in small batches. 1.6T has been tested at three customers; the main challenge is technical, centred on changes on the chip side.
quarterly_data.figure: first 3 NPO prototypes by the end of the month; small batch Q1 next year

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the gross-margin gain came from product mix, with the rising 800G share of module revenue lifting margin; management expects module gross margin to stay at the current high level and new-customer margins to be about the same as existing customers, as falling domestic supply-chain costs offset price pressure from leading North American cloud providers. The 800G unit price is currently US$300-380, averaging about US$350, and annual price declines are not expected to be large.

Management (IR record): working with a top industry customer generally requires at least 300-500 ten-thousand units a year of delivery capability before talks start; customers review technology, materials, sites, quality control and production management before ordering. Most customers have not agreed to disclosure of business details under confidentiality agreements; product-level shipment splits will be disclosed in the 2026 annual report.
quarterly_data.figure: at least 300-500 ten-thousand units/year delivery capability

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): silicon-photonics supply was tight earlier but has improved, with supply sufficient over the last two months; Cisco now attaches much more importance to silicon-photonics chip delivery than before, the company spent a lot of time cooperating on optimisation, and delivery capability has risen greatly.

Management (IR record): an 800G module's light source is typically 75 mW and a 1.6T module's typically above 100 mW (a 1-to-4 design using 75 mW needs a better technical solution); NPO mainly uses 120-200 mW lasers depending on the design. Laser purchases cannot be used to infer module shipments.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G light source 75 mW; 1.6T above 100 mW; NPO lasers 120-200 mW
